justification: Single-file frontend change: adds a PREVIEW_UNLOCK flag to ConveyancingTool so the team can view the full paid conveyancing PDF (DCP setbacks, shadow, bushfire, ANEF, contributions, corridors, TOD capacity, structures history, NARCliM climate, LEP clauses, full DA detail) without Stripe checkout or a named ?access= grant. No data-path, DB, or engine logic changes; production stays gated by default.
functions: N/A - one module const (PREVIEW_UNLOCK) and one changed derived value (unlockedReportId); no new function.
values: N/A - no DB or API values read; PREVIEW_UNLOCK reads two build-time env flags.
queries: N/A - no database access in this change.

break_it.scenario: NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEYANCING_UNLOCK is accidentally set to 1 on the production environment, giving the paid PDF away for free to every production visitor.
break_it.what_happens: The paid full PDF report becomes downloadable without checkout on the public production site until the env var is removed.
break_it.how: Production stays gated by default: the flag defaults to unset and unlock also requires NODE_ENV=development which Vercel production builds never use; the flag is scoped to the Preview environment in Vercel and is trivially revocable by removing it. Payments are additionally disabled today (WaitlistButton replaces Stripe), so no active revenue path is bypassed.
break_it.repro: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEYANCING_UNLOCK=1 on the Production scope in Vercel, redeploy, load /reports/conveyancing?address=... and confirm the download CTA renders; remove the var to re-gate.

break_it.scenario: The free-tier check returns a result with no report_id, so the unlock path has nothing to drive PDF generation.
break_it.what_happens: unlockedReportId resolves to null and the download CTA is not shown, falling back to the waitlist button with no crash.
break_it.how: unlockedReportId uses optional chaining and a null coalesce (result?.report_id ?? null); a missing report_id yields null rather than an undefined report id being passed to the generate route.
break_it.repro: Return a conveyancing result without report_id from /api/satellite/conveyancing and confirm the CTA does not render and no error is thrown.

post_merge.db_reset: Not required - no database or schema changes.
post_merge.secrets: No new secrets - adds one public NEXT_PUBLIC_ build flag documented in the PR.
post_merge.other_repo: No other repository is affected by this change.
post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - on the Vercel preview with NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEYANCING_UNLOCK=1: run /reports/conveyancing for a real address, click Generate and download PDF, confirm the full report renders all PDF-exclusive sections; then confirm production (flag unset) still shows the waitlist button instead of the CTA.
